experiments.description: Finite-size scaling law for valid regime boundary h_min(N)
experiments.hypothesis: h_min(N) = h_c + alpha * N^(beta) with beta ~ 0.5-1.0 (TFIM universality class, nu=1 in 1D)
Analytical theta from perturbation theory is within 5% of VQE-optimal at h>=2.0, eliminating seed sensitivity for the first sweep point.

experiments.description: TITAN parameter freezing: identify and freeze inactive HVA params
experiments.hypothesis: Second-layer HVA params (θ_zz2, θ_x2) are frozen for h>=1.5, enabling 40% VQE cost reduction with <1% accuracy loss.

experiments.description: Hessian-guided adaptive restarts reduce VQE cost
experiments.hypothesis: Hessian analysis at convergence identifies saddle points, enabling escape with 2-3 restarts instead of 5 blind restarts.

experiments.description: Physics-informed MPNN loss: MSE + λ·|E(θ_pred)-E_exact| improves deployment at boundary h-values
experiments.hypothesis: Adding energy validation to MPNN training improves ΔE/gap by 10-30% at h=1.25 (boundary) without regression at h=1.5.

experiments.description: Zero-QPU phase detection from MPNN weight gradient peaks
experiments.hypothesis: ||dW/dh|| peaks near h_c for MPNN trained on full h-range, but at training boundary for valid-regime-only MPNN.

experiments.description: Active learning reduces VQE data collection by 30-50%
experiments.hypothesis: Ensemble-based active learning achieves ΔE/gap < 5% with 10-12 training points instead of 17 (30% reduction).

experiments.description: TFIM + longitudinal field: 2D phase diagram with MPNN
experiments.hypothesis: HVA p=2 works for g<=0.3 and MPNN generalizes across g with (h, g) as input features.

experiments.description: DyPP extrapolation vs standard warm-start in descending sweep
experiments.hypothesis: DyPP linear/quadratic extrapolation reduces VQE iterations by 30-50% in the smooth regime (h>1.5) compared to standard warm-start.

experiments.description: Landscape fluctuation analysis for valid regime prediction
experiments.hypothesis: Landscape fluctuation (Var(E)/E_mean^2) drops sharply at h < h_min, providing a training-free predictor of the valid regime boundary.

experiments.description: Data efficiency: minimum VQE points for MPNN deployment
experiments.hypothesis: MPNN achieves ΔE/gap < 5% with 9-11 training points (vs 17 current) if uniformly spaced in [1.0, 2.0].

experiments.description: Ensemble uncertainty calibration: variance vs ΔE/gap
experiments.hypothesis: 5-MPNN ensemble variance correlates with ΔE/gap (r>0.7), enabling unreliable prediction detection without VQE.

experiments.description: Condition number κ predicts VQE restart needs
experiments.hypothesis: κ < 100 → 1 restart sufficient; κ > 500 → 3+ restarts. Enables adaptive restart allocation.

experiments.description: Cross-seed generalization: MPNN trained on seed 42, tested on 43/44
experiments.hypothesis: MPNN trained on seed-42 VQE data achieves ΔE/gap < 5% when deployed with seeds 43/44, proving it learns physics.

experiments.description: Entanglement entropy at h_min — explains scaling law causally
experiments.hypothesis: S(h_min, N) is approximately constant across N, meaning HVA p=2 has a fixed entanglement capacity ~0.5-0.8 bits. The scaling exponent β=1.33 is a consequence of how S(h, N) grows with N in the TFIM.

experiments.description: MC-Dropout UQ: calibrated uncertainty without extra VQE cost
experiments.hypothesis: MC-Dropout (50 forward passes) achieves Pearson r > 0.7 between predicted variance and actual ΔE/gap, vs G2's r=0.195.
